actions.name: get_records
actions.description: Records can be listed and filtered

actions.name: create_record
actions.description: Create a new record in the specified model

actions.name: update_record
actions.description: Update an existing record in the specified model

actions.name: custom_odoo_api_call
actions.description: Make a custom XML-RPC API call to Odoo

actions.name: get_record
actions.description: Get one record of any Odoo model by picking it from a list.

actions.name: delete_record
actions.description: Permanently delete a record of any Odoo model. This cannot be undone.

actions.name: run_record_action
actions.description: Run a button action on a record, for example confirm a quotation or post an invoice.

actions.name: post_chatter_message
actions.description: Log a note or send a message in the chatter of a record.

actions.name: attach_file
actions.description: Attach a file to a record, for example a signed PDF to a sales order.

actions.name: create_lead
actions.description: Create a lead or opportunity in Odoo CRM.

actions.name: create_sales_order
actions.description: Create a quotation (draft sales order) with order lines.

actions.name: find_invoices
actions.description: List invoices, bills and credit notes, filtered by type, status, customer and dates.

triggers.name: new_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a new record is created in any Odoo model (contacts, orders, invoices, tasks...).

triggers.name: new_or_updated_record
triggers.description: Triggers when a record is created or changed in any Odoo model. Odoo also counts automatic updates (computed fields, scheduled actions) as changes.

triggers.name: new_contact
triggers.description: Triggers when a new contact (person or company) is created in Odoo.

triggers.name: new_lead
triggers.description: Triggers when a new lead or opportunity is created in Odoo CRM.

triggers.name: new_sales_order
triggers.description: Triggers when a sales order is confirmed in Odoo, or when a new quotation is created.
